services.name: Swim Team
services.desc: Our Learn-to-Swim curriculum is one of a kind and developed over decades of swim instruction experience. We believe a safe play-based environment and a child-led instruction approach yields the best learning results for our swimmers. Each lesson begins with greeting your swimmer, then skill review and warm-up, leveled skill-work and finally reward time for swimmers to explore and bond with the water. Our instructors work to ensure each student feels welcome to the class and ready to learn new skills and/or grow current skills. services.desc: All of our swim instructors are experienced and excited to help you or your swimmer get the most out of private lessons. Please review the pool space chart below to determine which pool you/your swimmer should reserve! We also offer individual private lessons in which you reserve a single date and time. If you are interested in a weekly recurring semi-private lesson for two swimmers, we can accommodate you at the times offered for regular private lessons. services.name: First Day of Class
services.desc: Waterloo offers a number of Adult classes, including Learn to Swim, Intro to Lap Swimming and US Masters swimming. In our learn to swim classes, we offer both group and private lessons. We understand each adult comes to us with a different swimming (or lack thereof) background and develop a program to help them exceed their goals. ** No evaluation required**. Our Adult Lesson classes are: Adult Beginner and Adult Advanced. In the Adult Beginner class we work on introduction to the water building to 20 feet of free and backstroke. blurb: Waterloo has been such a productive and encouraging experience for all three of my children over the last four years! The teachers have created a swim culture that not only supports safe swimming practices but, most importantly, a true love of the water and the sport. Each coach we have had has been just as dedicated to my swimmer who is in Swim Fit as they are to my youngest, who is just starting purple.
